slots.root: flex flex-col gap-2 bg-surface border-[length:var(--bw-surface)] border-edge-surface rounded-surface p-surface min-h-30 shadow-surface-rest
slots.head: flex items-center justify-between gap-items
slots.label: font-face-label text-ctl-2xs tracking-label case-label text-ink-muted/(--level-ink-muted)
slots.value: font-face-heading font-heading text-h2 leading-snug tabular-nums tracking-heading
slots.delta: self-start inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-pill px-2 py-0.5 bg-transparent border-[length:var(--bw-marker)] font-body text-ctl-sm font-semibold
